question: Find the LCM of the fractions (2)/(5) , (3)/(7) and (4)/(9).
solution:
Given:

(2)/(5) , (3)/(7), (4)/(9)

Concept used:

LCM of the fractions = LCM of numerators ÷ HCF of denominators

Calculation:

LCM ((2)/(5) , (3)/(7), (4)/(9))

⇒ frac {LCM (2,3,4)}{HCF(5,7,9)}

⇒ 12/1

⇒ 12

**∴ The LCM of the fractions (2)/(5) , (3)/(7) and (4)/(9) is 12.**
